source: Owner supplied Google Cloud OAuth Clients screenshot plus explicit 2026-11-25 decision to keep Google Sign-In and Firebase in separate projects; public metadata only.

owner_approved_product_scope.backend: Laravel on cPanel PHP up to 8.4

web_oauth_client_from_screenshot.name: PuzzleQuest-Backend
web_oauth_client_from_screenshot.empty_origins_redirects_interpretation: Not necessarily an error when this Web client is used as a mobile native ID-token audience; if the implementer chooses browser-based code redirect, exact HTTPS redirect/origins must be authorized first.
web_oauth_client_from_screenshot.client_secret_handling: Do not copy any secret, partially masked secret, or screenshot into design artifacts, repository, app binary, admin preview, or release ZIP.
web_oauth_client_from_screenshot.photo_shows_secrets: yes masked; at least one entry shows Disabled; status of remaining secret cannot be verified from cropped screenshot

firebase_mobile_project_from_uploaded_cl.interpretation: Owner explicitly confirms Google Cloud puzzlequest-515809 is for login and Firebase puzzlequest50sols remains for mobile configuration/push. Distinct projects are intentional, NOT a pending owner decision; native OAuth client configuration, actual token aud, integration choice and tests remain engineering work.

authentication_design_contract.selected_product_behavior: Native Google Sign-In on Android/iOS then Laravel verifies the provider ID token; provider cancel returns silently, network error can retry, guest progress remains intact, Apple Sign-In stays absent.
authentication_design_contract.technical_integration_choice_requires_im: Owner approved separate Google Cloud login and Firebase mobile/push projects; engineers must select a compatible Google ID token acquisition and Laravel verification flow, never assume Firebase Authentication in a separate project automatically trusts this Web OAuth client.
backend_validation_requirements: Validate ID token signature against Google keys
Validate aud matches an explicitly accepted Web client ID, not an untrusted user-provided ID
Validate issuer and expiration and required replay/nonce protections as applicable
Key account on stable provider subject (sub), not display name or email alone
Server performs idempotent guest merge and preserves ledger; never trust a success flag from Flutter
android_missing_evidence: Android OAuth client registration for package + SHA-1/SHA-256 actual debug and Play App Signing certificates
Google provider enablement/consent screen publication/tester and verified token accepted by Laravel
ios_missing_evidence: iOS OAuth client registration for bundle ID
Native client ID and reversed URL-scheme configuration (keys absent from supplied plist)
iOS Google Sign-In token validation tested on device
authentication_design_contract.apple_app_store_review_gate: Apple App Review Guideline 4.8 may require an equivalent privacy-preserving login option; current Email+Password and Guest alone are not a verified exemption. Keep Apple disabled per owner and request explicit launch-compliance resolution rather than adding unapproved login UI.
authentication_design_contract.oauth_redirects: None registered in screenshot; DO NOT fabricate endpoints. A native ID-token-to-backend design does not require inventing a Google browser callback URL. A future redirect flow must separately approve and register its actual HTTPS callback.

decision_and_execution_gates.question: Owner approved separate projects. Implementation team chooses compatible native Google ID-token acquisition and server verification, checks aud against approved Web client, and documents Firebase usage boundaries; no extra owner choice needed.
decision_and_execution_gates.owner: Product technical lead / Google Cloud project administrator
decision_and_execution_gates.evidence: Cloud project in screenshot differs from Firebase client config project; neither mobile client config shows native OAuth client IDs.

decision_and_execution_gates.question: Owner has not created native OAuth Android/iOS clients. Developer registers Android client for package + actual signing SHA-1/SHA-256 and iOS client for bundle ID + URL scheme once signing/build data exists, then tests on both platforms. Never claim ready beforehand.
decision_and_execution_gates.owner: Android/iOS release engineer + Google Cloud administrator
decision_and_execution_gates.evidence: Native credential entries absent from supplied files, not proof that they are absent from Console.

decision_and_execution_gates.question: Confirm how iOS Google Login without Apple Login will satisfy Apple App Review 4.8 or provide reviewer-confirmed exemption.
decision_and_execution_gates.owner: Product owner + iOS App Store compliance reviewer
decision_and_execution_gates.evidence: Google sign-in is approved for iOS but Apple Login explicitly excluded in Q22.

owner_approved_project_separation.decision: intentionally keep projects separate, not an accidental mismatch
owner_approved_project_separation.firebase_auth_provider_choice: not decided by owner; technical implementation must choose and validate compatible authentication/token flow
owner_approved_project_separation.setup_timing: during development after Android signing certificate SHA and iOS bundle integration details are available; never postpone beyond Google login integration/acceptance tests
